name: Peluda OLD
savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Quill Thrust
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 10 feet attempts a melee Strike against the peluda

Effect The peluda shifts their position and makes a quill Strike against the attacking creature. This Strike doesn't count toward the peluda's multiple attack penalty, and the peluda's multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerable Tail
defensiveAbilities.description: If the peluda takes 30 or more slashing damage from a critical hit, the attacker severs the peluda's tail. The peluda takes 2d6 Bleed Damage and can't make tail attacks until their tail grows back (in about 1 week).

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The peluda breathes a torrent of flames that deals 7d10 Fire Damage damage in a 60ft Line (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

They can't use their Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Peluda Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 2 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Enfeebled 1, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Enfeebled 2, and off-guard (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Quill Barrage
offensiveAbilities.description:
The peluda bristles their quills and shakes, sending dozens of spear-like barbs in every direction. All creatures within 30 feet take 11d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save) and are exposed to peluda venom if they take any damage.

The peluda can't use Quill Barrage again for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Knockdown
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Knockdown in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Trip the creature as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty.
